about: The epistola of the formulary “Easter Sunday” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Brothers: Clear out the old leaven so that you may be a new batch of dough, just as you are unleavened. For Christ, our Passover lamb, has been sacrificed. So let us feast, not with old leaven, nor with the leaven of malice and wickedness, but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.

a.g: Christ, our Passover, has been sacrificed

ex.w015: Christus is the subject. Pascha nostrum identifies Him as our Passover, and immolatus est means “has been sacrificed”.
